Name: Pregnancy Choice
Author: Hanatsuki
Description:
This is a quick mod to allow you to choose a few options surrounding Pregnancy/Adoption.

The options are as follows:
Vanilla Behavior: No changes to the Pregnancy/Adoption dialogue. This is so you can basically toggle the mod off without uninstalling if you want to.
Spouse Pregnant: The spouse will always be the one to become pregnant no matter the player gender nor the spouses gender.
Player Pregnant: The player character will always be the one to become pregnant no matter the spouses gender nor the player gender.
Always Adopt: The baby will be adopted no matter the player gender nor the spouses gender.

You may want to consider using Pregnancy Role by Kdau instead once it is updated!
